items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 29 at 1:45PM PDT until September 30 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Strong rip currents. Minor tidal overflows, especially
during the late morning high tides.

* WHERE...Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands, Ventura County
Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Pooling of sea water is possible around high tide at
beach and harbor areas that is uncommon with normal tidal
ranges. Enhanced beach erosion is also possible. No significant
damage is expected. Rip currents can pull swimmers and surfers
out to sea.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.
